_description: Age 73, Traditional $500k + Taxable $100k, 10% deterministic stock return, no spending. Verifies RMD is calculated on the beginning-of-year (pre-growth) Traditional balance per the IRS Dec 31 prior-year rule.
_rationale: RMD = beginning Traditional / IRS divisor = 500000 / 26.5 = 18867.92. The 10% growth is applied first in the simulation loop, so the post-growth Traditional balance is $550,000. If RMD were calculated post-growth (the bug this test guards against), it would be 550000/26.5 = 20754.72 — ~$1887 too high. The correct value is 18867.92.
name: RMD Timing Positive Return
